channel.title: Xeroforhire — Press
channel.description: Official press releases and announcements from Jashae Slaughter (Xeroforhire) — writer, podcaster, musician, and founder of the Apocalyptiverse.

item.title: The Last Day: Issue II Arrives August 4 — And Rivers City Is Already Open
item.description: Apocalyptiverse Comics has released The Last Day: Issue II, the second chapter of Jashae Slaughter's black-and-white sci-fi series set in Rivers City. The issue is available to read now in the Reader Room at apocalyptiverse.com, a full week ahead of its August 4 storefront debut on Gumroad, GlobalComix, and Nerdanatix, with print editions from Amazon and Gumroad to follow. A full Origins press kit — world-building, a 12-question character FAQ, and credits — is available as a PDF at https://xeroforhire.com/files/the-last-day-origins-press-kit.pdf.

item.title: Apocalyptiverse Launches “Patriot Heroes” Card Set for America’s 250th Anniversary
item.description: 19 collectible cards, drawn from 16 original works by five independent creators, go live today — redeemable by code or directly through a new in-platform card shop. The Patriot Heroes set marks the 250th anniversary of the United States and introduces Alpha Red, Atreydean Justice, Zemara, and Starstruck to the Apocalyptiverse roster.

item.title: City Brawlers Officially Launches with Exclusive Patriotic Characters Pack
item.description: Apocalyptiverse has officially launched The Last Day: City Brawlers and released the Patriotic Characters Pack — a limited card set featuring exclusive variants of Iron Knight, Alpha Red, and Zemara, available now through the platform's pack redemption system at apocalyptiverse.com.

item.title: Apocalyptiverse Opens Submissions for 250th Anniversary Patriotic Card Set
item.description: Apocalyptiverse is opening an invitation to independent creators to submit original characters for a special commemorative, patriotically-themed card set marking the 250th anniversary of the United States. Each selected character is presented in a unified stars-and-stripes treatment and added to the platform as a pullable card in a limited release dropping just before July 4th. Patriotic themes are welcome but not required; submissions close July 3, 2026.

item.title: Xeroforhire.com Launches as Official Archive
item.description: Independent creator Jashae Slaughter has launched xeroforhire.com as the official home and archive for his creative work — a single, owned home for the writing, the podcast, the music, and the Apocalyptiverse, consolidating more than 14 years of work in one permanent, platform-independent place.

item.title: Battle Run Launches on Apocalyptiverse.com
item.description: Apocalyptiverse has released Battle Run, a browser-based card combat game set in the City of Rivers — the next step in a gamified sci-fi fiction economy where reading the books, collecting the cards, and playing the games are layers of a single connected universe.

item.title: Cyber Citizen Launches on Apocalyptiverse.com
item.description: Apocalyptiverse has released Cyber Citizen, a browser-based moral choice game set in the City of Rivers — where every decision shapes a citizen's morality, infamy, health, and addiction across a series of two-choice scenarios drawn from life in a dystopian city.

item.title: Apocalyptiverse.com Launches as an Interactive Fiction Platform
item.description: Independent creator Jashae Slaughter has launched apocalyptiverse.com — a browser-based platform combining collectible card packs, a live token economy, and original fiction set in the Apocalyptiverse universe, playable from any device at no cost to enter.
